meta.title: Prepare the PRs used in all cases

args.goal: Create or upload PR-1 through PR-12 in the buyer portal with the specified line items, categories, delivery locations, partially used quantity condition, missing category, missing subcategory, and many-FRUITS notification data; note each resulting PR number and stop after the PRs are created.

steps.note: Performs the required PR setup that has no dedicated catalog step and records the generated PR numbers.
Opens the Purchase Requisitions screen to verify the created requisitions.
Asserts that all twelve prepared PR records are present in the Open tab.
